dimensional_specification: Phillips pan-head self-tapper from supplied diagram and visual estimates

material.name: Black oxide steel
material.note: Visual finish approximation; catalogue specifies colour only.

modelling_choices.catalogue_length: Unlisted lengths use the sourced size profile at the catalogue length and are explicitly marked as extensions.
modelling_choices.certification: Visualization only; estimated features are not manufacturing dimensions.
modelling_choices.dimensions: Use the supplied head dimensions and pitches; 1 and 1.2 mm use the user's explicit 0.3 mm pitch. All lengths are measured beneath the head.
modelling_choices.display: Smooth pointed nominal thread envelope with the same recessed pan head.
modelling_choices.head: Estimated spherical crown uses up to 55% of head height, with a cylindrical skirt and a small 35%-head-diameter crown land to preserve the specified height around the recess.
modelling_choices.identity: User-authorized visual approximation of the supplied pan-head self-tapper; black catalogue finish retained. No DIN, ISO or manufacturer conformity claimed.
modelling_choices.markings: Unidentified manufacturer and property-class stamps omitted.
modelling_choices.recess: Estimated Phillips cross spans 52% of head diameter and penetrates 60% of head height; wing/core widths 16%/18% of head diameter, tapered walls and floor.
modelling_choices.runout: A short 0.12P blend joins the thread to a 0.015d head fillet; no plain shank.
modelling_choices.thread: Single-start right-hand helix, estimated core 0.65d, 60 degree flanks, and narrow 0.02P crest land. Core and profile are visual estimates, not metric threads.
modelling_choices.thread_coverage: Full thread to the head, with no smooth neck or length-dependent partial thread.
modelling_choices.tip: Estimated conical point one diameter long, capped at 60% of available shaft for unusually short edits. Thread and core taper together; no cutting flutes.

note: User-authorized image-based self-tapping visualization. Head dimensions and pitch are specified; core, point, crown and recess are documented visual estimates.

selection.identity_note: User selected the supplied dimensions, 0.3 mm pitch for 1/1.2 mm and 2.2 mm replacement on 2026-10-13, then confirmed full threading and authorized image-based core, point and Phillips recess estimates. Use a labelled visual approximation with black finish.

sources.title: User-supplied eBay dimensional diagram, image 6
sources.use: Diameter, head diameter and height; pitches at 1.4, 1.7, 2 and 2.2 mm.

sources.use: User specifies 0.3 mm pitch at 1 and 1.2 mm, corrects 2.3 to 2.2 mm, confirms thread to the head, and authorizes image-based estimates for core, thread shape, point and a reasonable Phillips recess.

product.orientation: lying on side, head to left
product.support: Head rim and threaded shaft rest on ground; solve tilt from mesh.
